author: Jules
name: LurkerKick
short: Kicks inactive users (lurkers) periodically or manually.
description: Kicks inactive users (lurkers) periodically or manually. You can configure the inactivity timeframe, excluded roles, and logging channel.
install_msg: Thank you for installing LurkerKick. Use `[p]lurkerkick` to view configuration commands.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores the timestamp of the last message sent by a user to track their activity.
